start.title: FeedbackY
start.intro: Anonymous feedback, questions and ideas for the talks at the Ludwig Boltzmann Institute.
start.howTo: To give feedback, scan the QR code shown at the seminar or open the link from the seminar email. No login needed.
start.step1: Scan the QR code at the seminar or open the link from the email.
start.step2: Vote and write comments for each talk. Nothing ties them to you.
start.step3: Speakers get one clear report: what is wrong, what to fix, what to decide.
